name: idle-compact
description: Compacts an idle session just before its prompt cache expires, so returning does not re-write the full context

ttlMinutes.title: Cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Treat the prompt cache as expiring this long after the last main-thread request

marginMinutes.title: Margin (minutes)
marginMinutes.description: Compact this long before the TTL so the summary request still reads a warm cache

minContextTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minContextTokens.description: Leave sessions smaller than this alone

instructions.title: Compaction instructions
instructions.default: Preserve the current task, open decisions, file paths touched, and next steps.
